summary: SK Telecom filed a Form 6-K announcing a mid- to long-term plan to pursue an AI data center buildout targeting 15 GW total capacity (first phase: 5 GW from 2029, later 10 GW from 2035). The filing is a forward-looking business plan review, not a definitive special situation transaction. No specific terms, deal price, stake percentage, or counterparty are disclosed. The board resolved on June 29, 2026, to announce the plan; funding may involve strategic partners but is undetermined. This is a routine disclosure of a strategic review, not an actionable special situation.
